source_text.GH#2697: PR 1 test-design gate: restricted-field request walker (query, join query, export), SEC R1-R6, code-gate B1.

task.description: Static review only (no mix/tests run, no mutants applied, per brief). Read-only.

result.summary: FAIL on one coverage gap (cheap rework), everything else passes static review. No @tag :skip, no TODO, no hardcoded secrets; fixtures per-test tenants with unique slugs, async:false, ColumnPromotion cleanup via on_exit, audit_entries rename is DDL inside the sandbox transaction; no test depends on another. NOTE: working tree was already committed as b10a1a8a2 when reviewed (git status clean for these files); the entities_test.exs diff was read via git show HEAD. COVERAGE VERIFIED present and non-skipped, each with refusal + permitted twin: filter (T-07, multi-clause), sort (T-08, T-22 row order C,B,A/A,B,C), export filter+sort (T-09/T-10), join on declaring=primary (T-11), =target (T-12/T-12b with other-user grant), =through near and far (T-13 x2 + twin), export+join, joined-entity redaction against own restrictions (T-31 x4), cursor key (T-25 incl. garbage cursor), aggregate unchanged (group_by and filter), likert_weight/likert_polarity/question.explanation queried:false and flipped queried:true (+grant makes 200), unknown field 422, T-15 uniform equality (filter, sort, join on, export x2, aggregate; status/type/title/detail), T-24, T-34a, T-34b, B1 query (ghost+through == ghost plain == type-denied), exemption export-only (T-18a inert on /query, T-18b flag false), T-17 audit exactly 3 name-only keys + no value in audit/log, T-37, T-33 (non-exempt none; refused and compile-422 none), T-32 audit failure -> 500 no records, T-38 logs, T-26 both directions (typespec tripwire + tracing builders), T-27, T-28, T-30 (1 and 2 loads), T-39 x3, T-40. REQ-311 AC3 alteration (moved restriction from through fk topic_id to non-fk note): intent preserved (a restriction row on the through type must not break joined-response redaction keys; the fk variant is now a by-design 403 covered by T-13). GAPS (blocking): G1 SEC B1 names 'through/direct join on /query and export'. Export + nonexistent primary + DIRECT join is not tested: in walker test 'B1 export' the variable `with_direct_join` is misnamed and actually sends @m2m_join (a through join) plus a filter, so it duplicates the through case. /query direct-join-on-ghost is covered (T-34a) but export is not. Add export(ctx, "ghost_q", %{"join" => @fk_join}) (fk_ctx) whose whole/1 equals plain export of ghost (404), and rename the misnamed variable. G2 (fold into the same rework): unit test 'nonexistent primary with a direct join' asserts only {:error, _reason}; pin {:error, :entity_type_not_found} so M11-direct is killed at unit level. ADVISORY (non-blocking): A1 T-18c is vacuous for the permission axis (TASK_WORKER fails the route-level EntitiesRecordsExport first; only admin roles hold both atoms), so no test kills a mutant that deletes check_unredacted_permission; accepted because the role matrix makes it unconstructible and the atom check is pinned in entities_export_test.exs, but the test title should say it asserts the route gate. A2 Audit-before-pagination ordering is not pinned (a mutant moving audit_exempted after Cursor.paginate survives; compile-before-audit IS pinned by the 422 test). A3 Aggregate 'measure' is named in the test title but the body covers only group_by and filter (aggregate is PR 2 scope; having coverage also deferred, T-14 only shows having is inert on the row routes). A4 No test combines the export exemption with a user_entity_grants row or a type-denied caller; no test of the 0051 D6 platform scope filter on the exemption. A5 T-39 and T-30 are source-grep/telemetry tests, brittle by design but acceptable as tripwires. MUTANTS (static reasoning, not measured): M1 killed (W T-08, T-22, T-25, T-10; filter (3),(4b),(5b)). M2 killed (W T-07, T-09, T-23/T-36; filter (2),(4a),(5a)). M3 killed (T-11 for dropped refs, T-12/T-12b for primary-set governance, T-13 near and far for hop/owner errors, export+join; U join_relations/field_refs/check_request tests). M4 killed for the flag variant (T-18b); permission-skipped variant NOT killable with stock roles (A1). M5 killed (T-18a, T-39 'exempt?: false' grep). M6 killed (U T-27, T-28; W T-26 for builder drift). M7 killed (U 'agree on membership' with granted? true, 'honours the caller's own grant'; W T-23/T-35/T-36). M8 partially killed: audit for non-exempt (T-33), audit before compile (T-33 compile-422), values in audit (T-17 keys exact + needle); audit-after-paginate NOT killed (A2). M9 killed (T-30 count==1/2, T-39 no load_restrictions in redact). M10 killed (T-24 byte-equality, T-34b: restriction on answer_option.question_id would 403 if the denied-type skip were removed). M11 killed for through (W B1 x2, U ':entity_type_not_found' through test); direct variant only killed on /query via T-34a, not export or unit (G1, G2). RECOMMENDED for ORCH to measure locally: M3 (both the primary-governs and far-hop-dropped variants), M5, M10, M11 (remove ensure_primary_exists), M8 audit-after-paginate (expected survivor).
